purpose: Replace Script82 4-Hz credited-player death geometry with raw pawn positions at the exact Trooper-death tick.
Compare credited last-hitter distance with nearest living allied-player distance.
Determine whether early AssignedGold target acquisition is better predicted by last-hitter proximity or by any eligible allied player being nearby.
Compare the resulting proximity scale with the previously observed ~735-HU stable-floor target-acquisition envelope.

semanticLimits.outcome: m_hVacuumTarget appearing <1 second remains an operational lifecycle outcome, not a direct engine vacuum-start event.
semanticLimits.nearestAlly: Nearest allied player is restricted to controller alive=true, pawn lifeState=0, and valid raw pawn position at the sampled death tick.
semanticLimits.radius: A classifier threshold is empirical. It must not automatically be promoted to an exact engine radius.
semanticLimits.rough45m: The ~45m value is retained only as a rough gameplay recollection and comparison scale, not a validation target.

interpretationGuide.creditedBetter: If exact credited-player distance remains substantially more predictive than nearest-allied distance, the last-hitter may have privileged initial-vacuum relevance.
interpretationGuide.nearestAllyBetter: If nearest eligible ally distance markedly improves classification, initial vacuum eligibility is more consistent with a team-level proximity condition rather than last-hitter-only proximity.
interpretationGuide.commonScale: If the strongest exact raw threshold is again near the ~735-HU stable-floor envelope, a common proximity scale becomes substantially more plausible.
interpretationGuide.broadScale: If exact raw geometry instead supports a materially larger threshold, initial post-kill vacuum and stable floor pickup may be distinct proximity regimes.
interpretationGuide.timingCaution: Poor prediction of the <=0.25-second field transition does not by itself reject a distance mechanic because m_hVacuumTarget may be populated downstream of the actual trigger.
